paragraphs: Rav Chilkiyah bar Tuvya, Rav Minyomi bar Chilkiyah, and Rav Huna bar Chiyya were sitting: Gittin 57a. Menachot 85b; Shabbat 96a. Eruvin 28b and Yoma 63a have bar Tuvi. Zevachim 114b, near the end, has Rav Chilkiyah of the house of Rav Tuvi; in the new Talmud editions' versions it should read “Nadar Chilkiyah bar Tuvya” [נדר, unclear]. And Rav Chiyya bar Rav and Rav Giddel bar Minyomi; see there. Perhaps Chama was his brother.
